name: scribe
description: Composable skills for reusable Knowledge, company Product and Technical Documentation, professional writing, and technical visuals.

interface.longDescription: Distinguish reusable Knowledge from company Product and Technical Documentation, assess boundaries and authority, structure stable responsibilities and conditional material, and create standard and high-frequency artifacts through explicit skill composition.
defaultPrompt: Use $ask-scribe to explain which Scribe skills fit my task and return a complete explicit invocation.
Use $structure-docs and $write-doc to plan a coherent documentation structure and migration map.
Use $reason-domain and $write-doc to assess this reusable Domain Knowledge boundary.
Use $structure-domain-docs, $reason-domain, $structure-docs, and $write-doc to structure this Domain Knowledge set.
Use $write-domain-doc, $reason-domain, and $write-doc to create the named Domain Knowledge document.
Use $write-architecture-knowledge, $reason-architecture, and $write-doc to create reusable Architecture Knowledge.
Use $reason-product and $write-doc to assess this company portfolio, product line, product, or product responsibility.
Use $structure-product-docs, $reason-product, $structure-docs, and $write-doc to structure this company's Product Documentation Set.
Use $write-product-doc, $reason-product, and $write-doc to create the named Product Internal Document Type.
Use $assess-product-lifecycle, $reason-product, and $write-doc to assess the next product decision and artifact coverage.
Use $reason-technical and $write-doc to assess this company's Technical Landscape and documentation responsibilities.
Use $structure-technical-docs, $reason-technical, $structure-docs, and $write-doc to structure this company's Technical Documentation Set.
Use $write-technical-doc, $reason-technical, and $write-doc to create the named Technical Internal Document Type.
Use $write-technical-architecture, $reason-technical, $reason-architecture, and $write-doc to define this company's Technical Architecture.
Use $draw-diagrams and $write-doc to create and verify the smallest useful visual for this document.
